what_this_is: A scope correction, not a retraction. The capability run was executed exactly as registered and its result stands. What was wrong was the INFERENCE carried from it to M4 — a statement qualified in one stochastic environment was read as if it held in another.

refers_to.note: Neither sealed artifact is modified by this erratum. Both remain exactly as written.

capability_result_as_qualified.scope: composition_world — the registered ComboLab v2 negative world
capability_result_as_qualified.qualified_statement: delta = +1.5 pp is detectable against the full 4,636-claim band UNDER THE REGISTERED COMPOSITION-WORLD PROCESS
capability_result_as_qualified.NOT_qualified: sensitivity under the empirical historical return distribution

the_measured_gap.why_band_ratio_exceeds_sd_ratio: the empirical distribution has far heavier tails (p1 -47 / p99 +64 against -16 / +18), and a within-stratum median difference on small arms is more sensitive to tail weight than the standard deviation alone suggests

what_went_wrong: combolab_v2.composition_world draws Y = mu_setup(sd 4.0) + gamma_date(sd 3.0) + eps(sd 6.0). Those constants were set for ComboLab v2's own world and were never checked against REALIZED_RETURN_TRAIL12_TIMER60_V1. Using the registered negative world was correct by protocol; failing to verify that its dispersion matched the outcome the search would actually run on was not, and nothing in the protocol required that check — which is why it is recorded here rather than treated as a slip.

consequences.for_the_capability_run: none — its scope is now stated explicitly instead of implied
consequences.for_M4: M4 is unchanged and is NOT re-interpreted. What changes is what may be SAID alongside it.
consequences.retracted_sentence: capability was qualified separately at 20/20 for a +1.5pp effect against this same band
consequences.why_it_was_false: the capability band was ~+1.03 pp; the M4 band is +4.83 pp. They are not the same band.
consequences.also_too_strong: no combination carries an incremental effect above +4.83 pp
consequences.why_that_is_too_strong: theta_hat is noisy in both directions. A true +5 can be observed at +4.2 and a true +4 at +5. The data support a statement about ESTIMATES against a band, not about which true effects exist.

what_M4_actually_supports: max theta_hat = +4.411 < band_p95 = +4.830, so none of the 4,636 estimated incremental effects crossed the registered search-wide band on this population. Nothing more.
what_remains_unmeasured: the detection capability of this instrument under the empirical noise structure. There is no single threshold X to report, because detection depends on support as well as effect size; the missing object is a surface DetectionRate(delta, support), not a number.

next_work_is_not_a_requalification.name: POST-M4 EMPIRICAL-NOISE SENSITIVITY CHARACTERIZATION
next_work_is_not_a_requalification.status: POST-EXPOSURE — historical Y is already open, so this carries no confirmatory standing
may_not: become a new PASS/FAIL gate applied backwards
choose delta to match the observed band
next_work_is_not_a_requalification.noise_generator: the real historical outcome vector, G1-permuted — keeping the true tails, scale and block heteroskedasticity while destroying any token-to-outcome association. Preferable to inventing a parametric simulator with sd 21.26, which would reproduce one moment and guess the rest.
next_work_is_not_a_requalification.design: nested: an outer G1 permutation builds each empirical-noise null world, delta is planted in a frozen needle, and 120 INNER G1 permutations build that world's band. Outer and inner RNG streams frozen and independent.

grid_frozen_in_advance.primary_if_cost_bound: q50 x all four deltas, then q10/q90

next_work_is_not_a_requalification.output: a DetectionRate(delta, support) surface, reported as a measured rate in a finite suite and never as a threshold

a_result_that_needed_no_new_computation: search tax was identical in both runs — the same 4,636 claims, the same k. Only the noise geometry changed, and the band moved 4.67x. Detection difficulty is therefore not a function of k alone but of k together with outcome scale, tail weight, stratification and support. That is a property of the whole system, not of this study.

standing_of_rank_1.may_not: be bootstrapped separately, tested without the search tax, given a different horizon, or have k reduced around it in order to rescue it
standing_of_rank_1.may: be described as the rank-1 historical candidate in post-search characterization

K2_note: K2 appears in 7 of the top 15 rows. That is one exploratory structure seen seven times, not seven independent pieces of evidence for K2.
